subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Begins to use past and present tense correctly

show.line: Today I jump. Yesterday I jumped. Words change when it already happened. Then and now!

rounds.prompt: Yesterday Sam ... in the pool. Which word?
Now the dog ... the ball. Which word?
rounds.praise: Now the dog kicks the ball.

rounds.prompt: Today I hop. Yesterday I? Say the word.

rounds.text: Yesterday I jumped in the mud.
accept: yesterday i jumped in the mud
yesterday i jumped in the mud.

rounds.prompt: Now or yesterday? Sort the words.

hints: Yesterday words often end in ed. Jumped, hopped.
Now means it is happening. Yesterday means it is done.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Yesterday I ... to school.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Yesterday is done. I walked to school.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Yesterday I walked to school!

parent_line: Can pick the right word for now and for yesterday.
